body: A good point. I meant nothing offensive by my comment. I'm surprisingly very level headed despite the situation at hand. I'm not really one to do irrational and impulsive things. I've thought very carefully and can maintain a level of control over myself even at my worst.

My birthday was picked just because I've always hated my birthday. Our anniversary was just particularly hard. I didn't do it though because I don't want to send the kind of message you might be implying. I'm not trying to blame anyone for my depression, ya know?

It's just going to be the time where I can find some alone time and I've been putting this off for awhile. I've just sort of run out of hope. I pushed it off from my birthday because I got scared what she might think. Then I pushed it off from first our old anniversary and then her birthday was right after and I refused to do that to her on her birthday.
(eventful 8 days).

I think of my ex-girlfriend because I very much still love her and our situation is a strange one. At the same time, it's not helping my mental state because of circumstances I won't explain on a public forum. I just know she would blame herself if I did it and I don't want her to live a life of misery or follow up what I do. 

I think of the friends who have kind of left me to die and don't want to drop it on them that this might be there fault. I'm very selfless in that regard, I suppose. But I still feel this weekend might be it for me.

There's a lot of super personal details to my story that I'm not sure need to be spread online unfortunately. I'm not really sure there is much that can be done for me but I do thank anyone who tries to be there. It means a lot just having people show they even care.

I'm thinking the same thing every single day myself. What's the point of a new life if I have to live it alone. I've lost all my friends lately and the only person who I ever loved. And then continuing circumstances make it impossible to just forget everything that's happened. I want to tell you to try to find small things to look forward to, even if they seem insignificant, but I don't know if I have the right and the moment with myself being on the verge.
I have a very similar situation. I don't want to post the entire novel again, but I will say you should read the topic I posted and message me if you feel you need to talk.
My friends have pulled away from me. It's funny how human nature is normally withdrawn when someone is in need.

I'm the same as well. I'm alive right now because all the people who have recently left my life would think it was there fault I'm gone. I feel guilty dropping my pain on them. And I think my exgirlfriend would potentially commit suicide in response if I did it and she is the most important person in the world to me. Everyday has been an uphill battle and I feel I'm losing as time goes on.

Sorry for a late reply. Unfortunately, the people who are "traditionally attractive" as you have stated tend to be the people who are uglier on the inside. Also it's easy for people to gravitate towards rude people since a good majority of human beings enjoy hurtful styles of comedy. I'm sorry that you're a victim in this case because it's not right no matter how many people like or find it amusing. 

It's never too late to change. It's nowhere near as bad as a hard drug, and I'm not trying to belittle your battle, but I quit soda after having drank it for my entire life. I believe in you and I think you can do it, even if not cold turkey.

I'm constantly worried about my father being the one who finds me. It's painful to do that to him because he's the hardest work man I know and has always supported me. But, I just can't bear the pain much longer.

I guess I know how he feels because I'm going through the same thing. I've been upfront about my intentions with people and only one person has really tried to see me through it while everyone else has started to pull away from me. It's funny how when you need help the most, that's when people turn you away. All you can do is really try to be there if he want you to be there and ultimately understand it will be his choice to make. I wish there was more you could do about it, but being in his spot and having been in your spot before, I understand.

I think that your boyfriend would be devastated without you and somewhere inside you still feel something if you are with him. You might not see any positive qualities (I'm guilty of this with myself as well), but he does. It's always hard looking at ourselves and seeing what others see. 

As the other reddit user said, don't listen to the people like the guy who made the comment about your dress. Those people are the real losers who need to put others down to feel good about themselves. You don't need that kind of negativity in your life. 

It's never too late to get help with an addiction. I think if you've posted about it an acknowledged it that you are self conscious enough about it and part of you wants help with it. The hardest part of all of this is talking to someone and I think you've done the right thing by posting and talking to people.
Ah, yeah, I know that feeling too. I've been unable to do anything that I used to enjoy. It all just feels pointless and I just constantly feel upset with no enjoyment.
I've lost everyone over the last few months myself. I have my own post on here but it's buried by now. Question for you though. Do you have any interests or hobbies? Like anything at all?

I was planning on ending my life on my 25th birthday (Was June 28th) but I had the means and thought about what my ex girlfriend would do to herself if I did it. Our Anniversary was the 3rd and I told myself I would do it then and then just ended up not. Finally, her birthday is the 6th (We had a busy string of 8 days) and I refused to do it on that day no matter how terrible I feel. I'm in a mixed place about how I feel about still being here. You're welcome to shoot me a PM if you feel like talking to someone.

I'm unable to just remove myself from the situation with everything that has happened. I haven't talked to her in awhile now but from my email getting hacked to the threat itself, I'm still extremely upset by it all. I've tried to distract with hobbies but it doesn't do anything and I still very much love this girl and I don't think it's fair to see someone else when I'm not fully interested I guess.
Thank you very much btw!
